title: Prompt input overlays and footer navigation
objective: Convert Swarm's prompt area into a bottom chrome state center with overlay-safe key handling, command completion portal behavior, and footer pill navigation for tasks, approvals, cache, Gateway, Symphony, and LSP.
actions: Define bottom-slot row budgets for prompt input, footer hints, completion overlay, and selected footer panels.
Portal slash-command completions into the fullscreen overlay layer when in fullscreen mode.
Prevent modal/overlay navigation keys from leaking into the text input while approvals, details, or footer dialogs are active.
Add footer pill selection and open actions for tasks, approvals, cache, Gateway, Symphony, and LSP.
Keep command completion, history navigation, and input editing behavior deterministic under small terminal heights.

criteria: Completion overlay no longer steals transcript rows unpredictably in fullscreen mode.
Footer pills are navigable by keyboard and open explicit detail surfaces.
Active overlays suppress text-input navigation without blocking ordinary typing when closed.
Short terminal tests verify input, footer, and overlay do not overlap.
Existing chat-input controller tests still pass.

non_goals: Do not redesign slash command semantics.
Do not expose all status detail in the default footer at once.
Do not add a new command framework in this task.
findings: Added a pure footer navigation model with deterministic next/previous/open/clear behavior for tasks, approvals, cache, Gateway, Symphony, and LSP pills.
ChatInputArea now renders compact footer pills with a selected state while preserving prompt editing and overlay completion behavior.
SwarmChatApp routes empty-input footer navigation keys to footer selection/open actions before conversation scroll handling, preventing footer navigation from leaking into text input.
